board: Pimoroni BH1745 Luminance and Colour Sensor Breakout (PIM375)
reason: Part check passed on ESP32 and Pico in the first run: the sim reads the red, green, blue and clear counts as little-endian 16-bit values at 0x50-0x57, part ID 0x0B at 0x40 and manufacturer ID 0xE0 at 0x92, all as in the ROHM datasheet. Header order 3-6V, SDA, SCL, INT, GND was read from the Pimoroni product photo.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0174/1800/products/BH1745_2_of_3.JPG (Pimoroni product photo, silkscreen 3-6V SDA SCL INT-symbol GND) and https://shop.pimoroni.com/products/bh1745-luminance-and-colour-sensor-breakout (Pi pins 1,3,5,7,9)
